calibration.limitation: Same evaluator flow and runtime but different policies, three not seven, run while training shares the GPU; wall time scales with surviving frames and small late batches. Factor 3 covers that, not a fresh per-policy calibration. Hard SIGALRM stop at work_seconds.
calibration.postflight_basis: total=work+cleanup(10)+postflight; prior observer-minus-worker 9.40 s x (RAW_CAP/prior frames 3.57) = 33.6 s; reviewed 120 s allowance kept. Worst-case bound, not expected runtime.

concurrency.shared_gpu_timing: may vary under concurrent training; wall bounds and caps unchanged

user_parallel_exception.scope: three completed policies evaluated while registered recovery training runs; one evaluation campaign; the earlier one-global-active-campaign rule was a thread guard the user relaxed for this scope only

shared_config.reward: score delta + alive_frames/100 - 5 on true death

provenance.claim: D4 is disjoint from the recorded accepted324 entity-teacher lineage, related recorded attempts and checkpoint selection/evaluation history. This is not a universal workspace nonuse claim.
provenance.d4_role: frozen full-run ranking/development cohort; not confirmation

semantics.rng_semantics: Before each policy: random, numpy, torch and torch.mps are reseeded with evaluation_rng_seed; categorical sampling uses the global MPS stream in fixed seed-batch order. Policies share the stream start, not per-seed action draws once trajectories diverge. No action-mode selection.

staging.rule: All six training definitions and terminal60 endpoints are fixed before D4 opens. The later three are evaluated once, in a separate reviewed run, with identical D4 seeds and settings; the first three are never re-evaluated. No partial result changes training, parent, seed vectors, checkpoints, stopping rule or selection.
